```yaml
name: Check Spy Versions

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  check-spy-versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run spy version check script
        run: ./ci/check-spy-versions.sh
```
